title: Journey - Seven Nights of Rest - Night 7: Sweet sleep

parts.style: warm, soft bedtime welcome, slow and unhurried
parts.text: Welcome to Seven Nights of Rest. <short pause> This is night seven, Sweet Sleep. <short pause> There is one light left, beside your bed. <short pause> You can leave it on, if the dark is hard for you. <short pause> And you can open your eyes whenever you need to.

Think back through the house. <short pause> The door is locked, and the day is handed over. <short pause> The kitchen is still. The curtains are drawn. <short pause> The desk and the shelf and the hall are dark. <short pause> Someone else is awake in this house, and He loves you. <short pause> So hear this promise, from Proverbs chapter three, verse twenty-four.

parts.style: reverent, very slow, reading scripture aloud
parts.text: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.

parts.style: tender, soft, slow, resting between sentences
parts.text: It says lie down, and then it says it again... as though to someone who sat back up. <short pause> Lie down. <short pause> You don't have to feel brave to do that. <short pause> Fear may come into the room. <short pause> It doesn't get to be the one who keeps watch.

parts.style: slow, deliberate, each phrase landing softly
parts.text: So here are all seven, one for every light. <short pause> The day is Yours. <short pause> I am counted. <short pause> I am covered. <short pause> Sleep is a gift. <short pause> Not mine to know. <short pause> Thank You. <short pause> I will not be afraid.

parts.style: prayerful, very slow, soft but clearly spoken
parts.text: Lord, thank You for these seven nights, and for all the nights to come. <short pause> Stay by this bed. <short pause> Make my sleep sweet... and when I wake, let me still be with You. <short pause> Amen.

parts.style: soft, very slow goodnight, resting between phrases
parts.text: Once more, very softly... and you don't need to reach the end. <short pause> The day is Yours... <short pause> I am counted... <short pause> I am covered... <short pause> Sleep is a gift... <short pause> Not mine to know... <short pause> Thank You... <short pause> I will not be afraid. <short pause> Goodnight.
